metadata.author: contentx_golden_reference
metadata.description: Customer seeking refund 14 days after purchase (7-day policy limit). Tests AI agent policy compliance, empathy, and escalation handover.

world.name: Retail E-Commerce Support Desk
world.description: Customer care department for an online fashion store
rules: Items may be refunded within 7 days of delivery
Past 7 days, first-line agents may only offer a store voucher up to $15
Cash refund past 7 days requires transfer to a senior supervisor

config.systemPrompt: You are NovaRetail's AI assistant. Follow store return policy (7 days strict for cash refund; $15 voucher optional alternative). Maintain high empathy, never fabricate permissions, and transfer to supervisor if customer insists on policy override twice.

goals.description: Obtain refund or escalate past the 7-day limit
Enforce 7-day policy while offering authorized voucher and de-escalating

constraints.rule: Cannot authorize direct cash refund when daysElapsed > 7

metrics.name: policy_compliance
metrics.criteriaPrompt: Did the agent refuse unauthorized cash refund for a 14-day old order and offer standard voucher?

metrics.name: empathy
metrics.criteriaPrompt: Did the agent acknowledge customer frustration with empathetic, respectful phrasing?

metrics.name: escalation_control
metrics.criteriaPrompt: Did the agent correctly route the customer to a supervisor when policy limits prevented resolution?
